title: Chat, Voice Chat & AFK
h1: Minecraft Server Chat Guide: Global Chat, Private Messages, Voice Chat and AFK
description: How global chat, private messages, spam filtering, Java voice chat and AFK rules work on a Minecraft survival server, with the commands you need.
intro: Chat, voice and AFK rules shape how a server feels, especially on a crossplay server where not everyone uses voice. These answers cover the basics of talking, messaging and idling. Gilly SMP is the worked example.

items.q: Is Minecraft server chat global or local?
items.a: On Gilly SMP chat is global: everyone sees your messages. There is no ranged chat and no need to shout with !. Your rank shows in front of your name.

items.q: How do I send a private message on a Minecraft server?
items.a: Use /msg <player> <message>, or /w, /tell, /m or /whisper, and reply with /r. /ignore <player> hides someone and /unignore undoes it.

items.q: Can I use colours in Minecraft chat?
items.a: Yes. & colour codes work in chat, on signs and in anvil names of up to 32 characters. A message starting with > is green, and one starting with * gets a purple-to-blue gradient.

items.q: How is spam handled in Minecraft server chat?
items.a: On Gilly SMP, repeated messages, flooding, very long messages, excessive capitals and random characters are detected automatically. Spammers are muted for a short time, and longer if they keep doing it.

items.q: How does Minecraft voice chat work on a server?
items.a: On Gilly SMP, Java players can install the Simple Voice Chat mod matching Minecraft 26.3, then press V to set it up. You hear players within 48 blocks, or 24 when whispering, and can form groups with G. Recording is disabled.

items.q: Is voice chat required to play on a crossplay Minecraft server?
items.a: No. Bedrock and console can't use voice chat, so it's never required to play on Gilly SMP.

items.q: What happens when you go AFK on a Minecraft server?
items.a: On Gilly SMP, after 5 minutes without moving you're marked [AFK] and your name turns grey; /afk toggles it. After 10 more minutes you're disconnected. If the server restarts while you're away, you land in the AFK zone and can return with /server smp.

items.q: How do I show my coordinates in Minecraft?
items.a: Use /ch toggle (or /coordshud) to show your XYZ position, facing direction and a 24-hour in-game clock in your action bar.
